title: The Cormorant Case
flavorText: The yacht never left its mooring, and yet the owner never saw the sun come up.
tagline: Locked from the inside, the cabin. That's what people always say when the door has no lock.
intro: Night of 3 September, jetty 7 in Port-Vendres. At dawn, Armand Delcourt is found dead on his bunk, the cabin door locked from the inside — or so everyone says. Four people were sleeping on board.

voices.helene: I never left his side all night. I'm the one who always sat up with him — always me.
voices.victoire: My papers were spread out everywhere, I work better at night. I could hear Oscar pottering about below — it was a comfort not to be the only one still up.
voices.pascal: On watch, like every night we're moored. You don't leave the helm just because the boat isn't going anywhere.
voices.oscar: I stepped out for air. I wasn't the only one not sleeping, believe me.
